semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: A durable economic resource transferred into the Fixed Assets subledger through an approved source event with cost, service date, category and ownership scope.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Epicor and Odoo connect acquisition to AP while Oracle distinguishes capitalized and CIP assets.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Inventory remains inventory until capitalization; Fixed Assets begins depreciation only after the capitalized event.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Effective-dated valuation context containing method, useful life, residual, convention, currency and posting behavior.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP depreciation areas and Dynamics derived books support accounting and tax valuations in parallel.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: The current single-book implementation is usable, but multi-book and tax-book readiness stay blocked until the contract and E2E accounting evidence exist.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Idempotent period-scoped batch that plans, posts or resumes asset depreciation and preserves each result and reversal.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP posts depreciation periodically and suites expose planned versus posted values.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: A run must respect open periods, currency precision, residual floors, idempotency and durable Ledger outcome.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Auditable retirement or sale that removes cost and accumulated depreciation, resolves proceeds and records gain or loss.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Dynamics propagates disposals across books and Oracle keeps retirement history effective-dated.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Sale requires AR/Tax handoff; scrap and sale remain distinct source events; corrections use reversal or reinstatement.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Opening cost and accumulated depreciation plus additions, disposals, depreciation and reversals equal closing balances and reconcile to Ledger.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP Asset History Sheet and Epicor reporting expose lifecycle and booked/planned values.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: A completeness claim requires subledger detail, Ledger balances, currency, cutoff and explainable differences.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Country-specific useful lives, conventions, limits and fiscal books are versioned policy consumed by one universal engine.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP charts of depreciation and tax books in other suites encode localization outside the core transaction.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Opening a country changes Control Plane/Country Pack data; engine code changes only for a new universal primitive.

northStar.bestVersion: A country-agnostic fixed-assets subledger where every capitalized cost, book, depreciation, transfer, impairment and disposal is effective-dated, reproducible, configurable and reconciled to Ledger across organizations.
businessOutcomes: Trace each asset from acquisition or capitalization through location, custody, depreciation and disposal.
Close periods with explainable net book value, rollforward and Ledger reconciliation.
Open countries and accounting bases by publishing governed books, methods and conventions without customer or country forks.
invariants: Only a capitalized asset is depreciated; inventory is never depreciated.
Posted depreciation and disposal history is immutable and corrected by reversal or reinstatement.
Depreciation never reduces net book value below governed residual value.
Every posting uses semantic account roles and reconciles to a balanced Ledger journal.
Method, useful life, residual, convention and book policy are effective-dated.
Legal entity, tenant, branch, currency and accounting period scope are explicit.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Asset classes, books, methods, useful lives, residuals, prorata conventions, fiscal limits, capitalization thresholds and semantic account roles are versioned Control Plane/Country Pack data; code owns universal lifecycle, strategy, calculation, idempotency and reconciliation primitives.

lessons.observedCapability: Depreciation areas support parallel valuations and configurable transfer to GL.
lessons.lesson: Book and posting behavior must be explicit dimensions, not properties hidden on one asset record.
lessons.ubpDecision: Keep current single-book claims bounded and require a versioned 1:N book model before multi-book readiness.

lessons.observedCapability: Primary and derived books propagate acquisitions, adjustments and disposals while preserving book-specific intervals.
lessons.lesson: Lifecycle events cross books, but each book retains its own schedule and posting behavior.
lessons.ubpDecision: Model lifecycle facts once and project them into independently governed books.

lessons.observedCapability: Methods, AP acquisition, GL automation and booked/planned reporting are integrated.
lessons.lesson: A useful asset module joins operational custody with the complete accounting lifecycle.
lessons.ubpDecision: Require source-document links, planned/posted state, Ledger handoff and rollforward evidence for every lifecycle claim.

lessons.observedCapability: Book facts are effective-dated; retirement and reinstatement preserve prior rows.
lessons.lesson: Changing depreciation policy must preserve what was valid at every prior cutoff.
lessons.ubpDecision: Use effective-dated book versions and explicit reversal/reinstatement rather than rewriting posted history.

lessons.observedCapability: Asset models configure depreciation, prorata, purchase-origin creation and disposal for SMB workflows.
lessons.lesson: Good defaults reduce capture while accounting controls still require reviewable source and board.
lessons.ubpDecision: Let Control Plane templates propose asset setup, then require approval before capitalization and posting.

gates.purpose: Validate the closed V11 contract, capability and deterministic routing.
Require active ownership, approval, pinned revisions, fresh market evidence and resolved seeds.
Resolve ADR-0029, accepted CAPAs and implementation anchors against the pinned UBP graph.
Require asset master, supported strategies, schedule and user/API path.
Require period-safe posting, reversal, rollforward and subledger-to-Ledger reconciliation.
Require auditable acquisition state, custody and disposal result.
Keep parallel and fiscal books blocked until configuration and E2E evidence exist.

enforcement.readyWhen: The expert contract, market lens and Graphify anchors validate, making Fixed Assets an active product authority. Core master, supported depreciation, batch, posting/disposal and reporting claims follow their evidence; advanced books, local tax rules, impairment, CIP, acquisition and transfers remain BLOCK until dedicated gates pass.
